scripts.lint: (bun scripts/check-lint-lists.ts && bun ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings src plugins tests scripts perf && oxlint --config tools/oxlint/no-zod.json --disable-nested-config --ignore-pattern 'tools/oxlint/anti-slop/vendor/**' tools/oxlint && oxfmt --check) || { printf '%s\n' 'For tool-fixable lint and formatting findings, run make format.' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.oxlint: oxlint --type-aware -c tools/oxlint/oxlint.config.ts --disable-nested-config src plugins tests scripts perf
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
